source_integrity_notes: Study-selection count conflict: Results prose says 162 met inclusion criteria, while Figure 1 says 159 included. The reported 58 studies plus 101 case reports also totals 159.

Table 1, Manchikanti et al. 2014 row lists 120 patients and 688 injections but prints 6 subarachnoid punctures as 0.3%, 10 intravascular penetrations as 0.6%, and 3 nerve root irritations as 0.76%. Those percentages do not match the printed counts if 688 injections is the denominator. The values were not repaired.

Table 3, Manchikanti et al. 2012 row lists 1,310 injections and prints 16 transient nerve-root irritations as 4.6% and 8 profuse bleeding events as 1%. Those percentages do not match the printed counts if 1,310 injections is the denominator. The values were not repaired.

Infection-frequency statements differ within the article. Section 4.5 gives about 1 infection per 60,000 to 100,000 epidural injections, while the Discussion gives severe spinal-injection infection incidence of 0.1% to 0.01%. The source does not reconcile the definitions or denominators.
extraction_limitations: The source is a 2015 systematic review. The LiteratureAtom schema is oriented toward primary literature and has no dedicated systematic-review synthesis kind.
Bibliographic entries were not atomized. Selected study-level numerical findings are tagged secondary_reported_result and remain anchored to this review, not to the cited primary paper.
The review did not report a formal risk-of-bias tool, evidence-certainty framework, or pooled meta-analysis of complication incidence.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No external bibliographic correction, guideline update, regulatory update, or current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
